plotEn:
In a remote facility in New Mexico, Nazi scientist Dr. Hans Kammler conducts research to develop a trio of super soldiers on behalf of the United States government. Three subjects, dubbed Crybaby, Cockroach, and the Butcher, were selected from US military personnel based on a demonstrated ability to survive and kill without mercy. Through surgical modification and psychological conditioning, they have been imbued with enhanced strength, endurance, durability, muscular control, night-vision, and a relentless drive to kill.
Government agent Baylor observes an exercise in which regular soldiers test the trio's abilities. All three seemingly die from cardiac arrest, but have in fact consciously lowered their heart rates to appear dead. When their supervisors unknowingly enter the arena, Hans, Baylor, and Baylor's men are all killed and the trio flee from the facility.
A former Army sniper named Celeste manages a nearby trailer park with her daughter Daisy. Celeste tells Daisy about a fellow soldier who challenged her to a fight. The soldier, who became the Butcher, chose Celeste because he believed she was an easy target. Celeste won by kicking him in the testicles.
The trio slaughters everyone in a truck stop and head to the trailer park in a stolen truck. A government operative named Cyrus has been deployed to contain the situation.
